value.text: {"claims":[{"quote":"Seven of the nine said that when they test the new Siri \"complex request\" flow, the system prompt that appears the first time asks users to approve processing by a \"partner model\", and the network traces they captured show calls going to Google-owned endpoints.","tickers":["AAPL","GOOGL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"iOS 27 beta Siri complex requests routed to Google-owned endpoints","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"one agency lead estimated 25-30% of their test Siri sessions are being handed off rather than handled on-device, higher than the 10-15% they expected from Apple's WWDC messaging.","tickers":["AAPL","GOOGL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"share of test Siri sessions handed off rather than handled on-device","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"two developers said an Apple contact told them there would be \"no per-call charges to developers,\"","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"per-call charges to developers for Siri handoff","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"If the handoff share is genuinely this high, it would point to more Google cloud/model usage tied to the iPhone installed base than we think is modeled, and to a possible AI cost line for Apple.","tickers":["AAPL","GOOGL"],"entities":[],"kind":"opinion","metric":null,"period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false}]}
